title: Hosting account services, backup and encryption settings
what_it_shows: One managed application platform service (web application and job worker), one managed database and one object storage bucket for photo uploads, all in one region; HTTPS only with managed certificates on every public endpoint; database, backups and object storage encrypted at rest by the provider; database daily automated backups kept 7 days and 7-day point-in-time recovery, stored in the same provider account; photo storage has versioning off and no backup or copy job; the backup activity list shows one backup export in April 2026 and no restore to a separate instance

title: Hosting account members, API tokens and audit log settings; messaging and model API key pages
source_system: Hosting provider console (SYS-01); email service, SMS provider and model provider consoles
what_it_shows: The owner is the only console member, with authenticator-app MFA; one hosting API token with full account scope, created in 2024 with no expiry and never rotated, used by CI; the database password has not changed since the database was created; the email, SMS and model provider API key pages show each key's creation date and no rotation; the account audit log keeps 30 days of console and API events, with no export or alert set up

title: Product admin console walk-through
what_it_shows: The admin console has one role (super-admin) and one account, the owner's, which signs in with a password only; the console can open, edit and export any subscriber account; no record of console actions is kept; the owner states that the support contractor signs in with this account for setup help

title: Application sign-in and password settings
what_it_shows: Subscriber staff passwords are salted and hashed by the framework, with an 8-character minimum and no check against known breached passwords; subscriber staff have no MFA option; sign-in rate limiting allows 10 failed attempts per account per 15 minutes and slows repeated attempts from one address; framework authentication applies to every route; the application logs sign-ins, failed sign-ins and errors

title: Subscriber, staff account and client record counts
source_system: Production database report run from the admin console (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: About 240 active subscriber accounts (1 to 9 locations each) in 11 states, about 70% of them in Florida; about 520 subscriber staff accounts; about 88,000 end-client records, about 61,000 with a Florida address or phone number; 31 closed subscriber accounts whose records and photos remain in the database and photo storage

title: Public booking page and form field review
what_it_shows: Booking pages are general-audience pages; the form collects name, mobile phone number and email, a home address only for home-cleaning and mobile grooming services, pet names and optional reference photos; parents book for children with their own details and there are no child profile fields; subscriber staff add free-text service notes; there are no fields for government ID, card or account numbers, health records or precise location; deposits open the payment processor's hosted checkout page

title: Smart Replies feature flags and prompt template
source_system: Application feature flag settings and code repository (SYS-01, SYS-02)
what_it_shows: Smart Replies was turned on for 30 opt-in beta subscribers on 2026-06-15; 6 of them have 'auto-send for booking confirmations' on; the prompt template sends the client's first name, the message, upcoming appointments, open slots and the client's full free-text service notes to the model provider; drafts are labeled 'AI draft' in the subscriber inbox; no code checks draft times or prices before display

title: Repository, CI and dependency alert settings
what_it_shows: A private product repository and one public demo repository; the owner is the only member, with authenticator-app MFA; CI deploys with the hosting API token stored as a CI secret; secret scanning and push protection are off; dependency alerts are on, and the open alerts carry no triage notes, assignees or dismissals; about 1,100 unit and integration tests run on every push, none covering tenant isolation, authorization, export or deletion; release history shows framework updates about monthly

title: Error monitoring settings and sample error events
what_it_shows: Error events capture request data, and some recent events include end-client names and phone numbers; retention is 90 days; data scrubbing is off

title: Uptime monitor 12-month report
what_it_shows: Measured availability of 99.82% over the 12 months ending 2026-08-17; the 14-hour outage on 2026-03-11 is the largest event

title: Status page incident history and March 2026 cancellations
source_system: Status page (uptime monitoring service, SYS-06); payment processor cancellation records (SYS-05)
what_it_shows: One major outage in the last 12 months: 14 hours on 2026-03-11 after a failed database migration; 3 subscribers cancelled after the outage and gave it as the reason, about $2,300 a year of subscription revenue

title: Help desk user list and security settings
source_system: Help desk and live chat service (SYS-07)
what_it_shows: Two named accounts, the owner's and the support contractor's; MFA is available and not enforced

title: Back office account security pages and password manager report
source_system: Business email and file suite, password manager, payment processor and accounting SaaS consoles (SYS-05, SYS-08)
what_it_shows: Authenticator-app MFA is on for the business email and file suite, the password manager and the payment processor; the file suite keeps version history; the password manager report shows a unique password for every saved login, no emergency access contact and the secrets feature not in use; the accounting SaaS has two users, the owner and the CPA firm

title: Laptop settings and contents review
source_system: Laptop settings screens and file system (SYS-09)
what_it_shows: Full-disk encryption, automatic OS updates, built-in antivirus and the host firewall are on, with a screen lock set; personal accounts and software are also installed; the project folder holds a plaintext .env file with the hosting API token, the database connection string with password, and the messaging and model API keys; the local development database holds a full copy of production data restored from a backup in April 2026; the browser holds signed-in sessions to the hosting console and the repository

title: Mobile phone settings review
what_it_shows: Passcode and device encryption on; automatic updates on; the authenticator app on this phone holds the second factor for every account; no second authenticator device or hardware security key is registered; no recovery codes are stored offline

title: Home office walk-through
what_it_shows: One home office in Florida and no other premises; the laptop and phone are the only devices; no paper records or removable media hold subscriber or client information; the laptop travels with the owner; the phone hotspot is the backup internet connection

title: Previous laptop trade-in confirmation
what_it_shows: The previous laptop was traded in on 2025-03-18; the confirmation records the device as received factory reset, and the order notes that full-disk encryption was on

title: Terms of Service and Data Processing Addendum
what_it_shows: Click-through terms adapted from a template in 2024: subscriber data is used only to provide the service; notice of a security incident affecting subscriber data without undue delay and within 72 hours of confirmation; a public sub-processor list with 14 days' notice of changes; deletion of subscriber data within 30 days after account closure; data export on request; no uptime service level

title: Negotiated DPAs with the two larger subscribers
what_it_shows: A 9-location salon group and a pet grooming franchise group signed negotiated DPAs with 48-hour incident notice and an annual security questionnaire

title: Public sub-processor list
what_it_shows: Five entries: the hosting provider, the email service, the SMS provider, error monitoring and the help desk; the AI model provider is not listed; the page repeats the 14-day notice promise

title: Vendor terms folder
source_system: Vendor terms folder (saved online terms and accepted DPAs)
what_it_shows: The hosting provider's terms include a DPA; the email service DPA was accepted online; the SMS provider, error monitoring, help desk and payment processor are on standard online terms; the AI model provider is on its standard API terms, with no DPA, order form or saved copy of the terms; each provider's terms name a U.S. contracting entity

title: Support contractor agreement and consultant engagement letter
what_it_shows: The freelance support agreement (about 10 hours a week) has a confidentiality clause and no security terms, no incident reporting duty and no step to remove access when the contract ends; the contract security consultant's engagement letter for the August 2026 review covers a secret scan, a configuration review, a restore test witness and a challenge of the self-review, under a nondisclosure agreement and with no standing access

title: Business bank and card statements, 2025-08-01 to 2026-07-31
source_system: Business bank account and card statements
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the hosting provider, the source repository and CI service, the email service, the SMS provider, the AI model provider (from June 2026), the error and uptime monitoring service, the help desk, the business email and file suite, the accounting SaaS, the password manager, the domain registrar and an AI coding assistant plan; monthly payments to the support contractor; payments to the CPA firm; payment processor fees deducted from payouts; the accounts are held in the owner's name as a sole proprietorship; no payment for cyber insurance, outside counsel or security training

title: Subscription billing report, 12 months to 2026-07-31
what_it_shows: About $180,000 billed in the 12 months, about $15,000 a month, from about 240 active subscriptions at $39 to $129 a month; failed charges are retried automatically over several days; no revenue other than subscriptions

title: Website security page and Smart Replies release note
what_it_shows: The security page states 'bank-level 256-bit encryption', 'automatic backups every day', 'we never share your data with third parties' and '99.9% uptime'; the Smart Replies release note (June 2026) states 'your data is never used to train AI'; the site has no security contact address or vulnerability disclosure page

title: Security questionnaire answer document
what_it_shows: The answer document, last edited in November 2025, states that every administrator has an individual account with MFA and that a SOC 2 report is planned

title: Subscriber security questionnaires and SOC 2 requests
what_it_shows: About 6 subscriber security questionnaires in the last 12 months, answered from the answer document; both negotiated-DPA subscribers asked for a SOC 2 report, and the owner replied that one is planned

title: Sent mail review: subscriber exports and notices
what_it_shows: Subscriber data export requests were answered by emailing a CSV file as an attachment; no sub-processor change notice was sent to subscribers in 2026

title: Hosting provider SOC 2 Type 2 report
what_it_shows: Type 2 report on the Security and Availability categories for the 12 months ending 2026-03-31, unmodified opinion; the system description covers encryption at rest, backups and point-in-time recovery and lists complementary user entity controls; one exception (2 of 40 sampled provider staff terminations removed access after the 1-day target), remediated; data center operators are carved out

title: Technology errors and omissions quote with cyber endorsement
what_it_shows: A technology errors and omissions policy with a cyber endorsement was quoted on 2026-07-14; no application was signed and no policy was bought

title: Search of the owner's files for security documents and training records
what_it_shows: No written security policy, risk assessment, incident plan, contact list, restore steps, retention schedule, data inventory or vendor review record was found; no security awareness or secure coding course certificate; no engagement of outside or breach counsel

title: AI model provider account and usage page
what_it_shows: API account opened in June 2026 on the provider's standard online terms; Smart Replies requests start on 2026-06-15; one API key; no DPA, order form or signed terms in the account

title: AI coding assistant plan and terms
source_system: AI coding assistant account and plan terms page
what_it_shows: Paid individual plan used in the owner's code editor; the plan terms state that inputs are not used for training

title: BIA worksheet
what_it_shows: For each of the five business functions, the owner's account of the systems and vendors used, the manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss the function can tolerate; subscribers run their working day from the calendar; next-day reminders go out at 10 a.m. and each location receives a 6 a.m. day digest email; personal savings cover about two months of expenses; the owner is the only person who can deploy, restore or rotate a secret

title: Risk walk-through of data, secrets and access paths
source_system: Owner-developer's written walk-through of the platform, the laptop and the SaaS accounts
what_it_shows: Where subscriber data and secrets sit day to day (production database and photo storage, the laptop's .env file and database copy, CI secrets, error reports, AI prompts, emailed exports) and who can reach them; the long-lived hosting token can deploy code, read settings and delete backups; browser sessions on the laptop stay signed in for weeks; no alert is set for new sign-ins, new tokens or bulk database reads; the home office is the only work location

title: Code review of tenant scoping and framework security defaults
what_it_shows: Every database query goes through one shared query helper that adds the account ID, with no second isolation layer; framework security defaults (CSRF protection, parameterized queries, output encoding) are on; the hosting provider's hardening guide settings applied at setup are still in place

title: Owner test of account deletion and client export
source_system: Test subscriber account on the production platform (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Deleting a test subscriber account removed its database records and left its uploaded photos in storage; a client export produced a CSV file, which the export procedure sends to the subscriber as an email attachment

title: Gap analysis self-review
source_system: Owner-developer's written answers to the FTC guidance questions, checked on screen with the consultant
collected_by: Owner-developer with the contract security consultant
what_it_shows: The owner is self-taught and has had no security or secure coding training; the running application has never been scanned or tested for common vulnerabilities; provider security bulletins are not followed; there is no retention schedule; the business keeps no paper or removable media

title: Consultant configuration review and TLS scan
source_system: Hosting console, database and storage settings; TLS scan of public endpoints
collected_by: Owner-developer with the contract security consultant
what_it_shows: TLS 1.2 or higher on every public endpoint, with HTTPS redirects and HSTS set by the application; only the web endpoints are exposed and the job worker is private; photos are served from object storage through public links that never expire; the database accepts connections from any address with the password

title: Control assessment: privileged account review and contractor interview
source_system: Admin console user list; interview with the support contractor; owner self-review
collected_by: Owner-developer with the contract security consultant
what_it_shows: The admin console has one super-admin account; the support contractor confirmed signing in with the owner's login, from the contractor's own unmanaged device and from any location, and that no step removes this access when the contract ends

title: Control assessment: log review self-review
source_system: Hosting audit log; repository security log; application sign-in log; owner self-review
collected_by: Owner-developer with the contract security consultant
what_it_shows: The hosting audit log (30 days), the repository security log and failed sign-ins have never been reviewed; admin console actions are not logged; no process exists to record or act on review results, or to review more often after an incident, a provider notice or an exposed secret

title: Control assessment: restore test
source_system: Point-in-time restore of the production database to a scratch instance; test notes
collected_by: Owner-developer with the contract security consultant
what_it_shows: First restore test: the restore took 2 hours 10 minutes, 40 of them spent finding the right commands; row counts and checksums of sample tables matched; no written restore steps or test frequency existed; photo restore was not tested; the owner and the consultant reviewed and recorded the results the same day and the scratch instance was deleted

title: Control assessment: backup review
source_system: Hosting backup and photo storage settings; repository; restore test
collected_by: Owner-developer with the contract security consultant
what_it_shows: The database is backed up daily with point-in-time recovery and backups are encrypted at rest; uploaded photos have no versioning or backup; code, platform configuration and CI configuration are in the repository with a full clone on the laptop; security documents are in the file suite with version history; all backups sit in the production account, which the CI token and a console session can administer

title: Control assessment: administrator sign-in tests
source_system: Account security pages; sign-in tests from a new browser
collected_by: Owner-developer with the contract security consultant
what_it_shows: The hosting console, repository, business email, password manager and payment processor required the second factor; the domain registrar and the product admin console signed in with a password only; the registrar account was not on the owner's list of administrator accounts; repeated failed sign-ins to a test subscriber staff account were slowed and then blocked after 10 attempts

title: Control assessment: secret scan
source_system: Laptop files; secret scan of every repository including history; hosting and CI secret settings
collected_by: Owner-developer with the contract security consultant
what_it_shows: A plaintext .env file on the laptop holds the hosting API token, the database connection string and the messaging and model API keys; the scan found an old hosting API token in the public demo repository's commit history, revoked in 2025 when the owner changed hosting plans and no longer usable; the current token was not found in any repository; the hosting token list shows one full-scope token created in 2024; hosting and CI secret stores are encrypted

title: Control assessment: incident reporting self-review
source_system: Contractor agreement; contact lists; DPA notice clauses; owner self-review
collected_by: Owner-developer with the contract security consultant
what_it_shows: The support contractor has no duty or time limit to report suspected incidents; there is no list of subscriber security contacts, counsel or law enforcement to notify; the two 48-hour customers are not flagged anywhere

title: Control assessment: dependency alert review
source_system: Repository dependency alerts and alert settings; owner self-review
collected_by: Owner-developer with the contract security consultant
what_it_shows: Dependency alerts are on and raise new advisories with CVE identifiers and CVSS scores; 14 alerts were open on 2026-08-27, 2 of them high severity and open for more than 30 days, none triaged; no fix times are defined; the running application has never been scanned and no checklist-based configuration scanning is in use

title: Control assessment: service provider review
source_system: Vendor terms folder; public sub-processor list; contractor agreement; hosting provider SOC 2 report; owner self-review
collected_by: Owner-developer with the contract security consultant
what_it_shows: No security requirements for providers were written down; the AI model provider is used on its standard API terms with no DPA or written no-training terms and is not on the public sub-processor list; the contractor agreement has no security terms; no oversight steps are documented and no provider report or security page had been reviewed; customer responsibilities for the hosting platform are listed in its SOC 2 report

collected_by: Owner-developer with the contract security consultant
